verdict.summary: Round 2 remains clean. The opt-in binary is correctly gated by the stdio feature, defaults to fail-closed read-only operation, preserves named graphs through dataset loading, and reserves stdout for JSON-RPC. The spawned-process tests exercise the real binary path for loading, tool advertisement, mutation refusal, mutation enablement, empty input, help, and startup failures; the focused loader tests cover named-graph preservation and malformed/unreadable input. Documentation and the public-surface skill match the implementation. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect requiring changes was found.
